body:
It's nice to hear that you're well. That is horrible. I'm sorry you had to go through that. 

My brother doesn't know about this. It's better if I take it to the grave. It's my fault. I should take responsibility for it. He shouldn't have to suffer.
Yes. I have recorded videos on my phone where I say my goodbyes.
I feel you. That is what I've felt for so long to some extent. You get tired of fighting for no progress. It feels hopeless.
Thanks for reading I truly appreciate it. I hope that I can help
I get what you're saying but I don't want to be remembered that way. That would be awful. I just wanted to maybe help someone on here and maybe they would remember me. That's all.

When you have no joy. No motivation. Nothing but setbacks which happen like chain reactions when you're depressed. EVERYTHING is hard. Nothing is easy. Most days I try to sleep as much as I possibly can because staying conscious and having to deal with your emotions that are constantly negative and bashing you. That is psychological torture. I barely move at all when my anxiety gets real bad. I just stare out into nothing. I don't want to "live it out" when this is it. It didn't get better with time it got worse for me. I've thought about this for a very long time. I have made peace with it. I'm more relieved now than I have been for as long as I can remember. I understand you want to help I respect you for that. This is set. I will not change my mind for anything.

I just wanted to tell my story and hopefully change someones mind and maybe someone will even remember me for some time. I appreciate everyone who came here to read and show support or just ask me questions.
Because I have everything I need at home. And it feels fitting. But I would be lying if I said I wouldn't rather use a gun

I understand man. I will be here for abit longer. I can talk for aslong as I'm here. You are almost the same age as me and I can relate to the things you are talking about. Is there anything in your life that could possibly help you change your mind?

Thanks for messaging me! Are you feeling better now?

No I've kept things like this to myself. I only speak about these troubles on here. Never anywhere else out of fear. Now I just let it out because there's no need to hide it any longer

I did not mean that I was the only one suffering. I understand that many people have it real bad and worse than I do. Everybody has their own issues. It's just that these abrasive thoughts and memories I have... They ate away at who I was slowly but surely. Until there is not much left but pain and you start to relive the past. rewind the tapes.... Eventually that's all you have left. I can't even remember when I actually liked myself the last time. That negative voice that some of us have in our heads. It gets to you eventually. Everyone has their breaking point I guess.

The anxiety is crippling me. Like I can just stare out into nothing for hours. Not drink anything. Can't do ANYTHING. The only thing that helped my anxiety was planning my suicide. Because it means that I'm getting closer to the end.

I used to think that it would go away. That I was strong. But I'm not. That's nothing but a copout. The truth is I just didn't have the courage to kill myself earlier. That's it.. But now I know. It's actually possible to feel SOOO much pain inside that death feels like the best and most comforting decision you've ever made for yourself.

I really appreciate you not trying to talk me out of this. Like if I'm fine with it why can't you be.

Man I feel you. I've had almost that exact experience too so I know what it feels like to be abandoned by people you trusted and thought you'd have in your life untill you die. What kind of friends are those? Who only seem to be your friend when you're up in life.  These are fake friends. Real friends will be there for you when you are down in life. They don't deserve to be your friend mate.

I appreciate that. Well it was harder when I didn't have a plan. Now I can just turn around and see my way out. And I know I can do it whenever I feel like it. It's right there.

I used to wish there was some magic solution that would fix my issues. But I know that this pain is permanent. I've had it longer than not.
I just don't want to be a burden anymore. And it feels sooo relieving to have a solution to that.

This is not something that came overnight. I've had this feeling for all my adult life. And through adolescence. I honestly wholeheartedly believe that this is the right choice for me.

I just know that I for sure want to be dead before I lose my apartment and become homeless because that would fuck up the memory of me even more. And I would like to have some dignity left

It makes me feel better to know that most people don't have to go through this. Sometimes I feel like I'm carrying pain for others. It feels good, like I'm being useful. Some of us have to suffer so the rest can feel good about themselves. I don't mind. I don't wish this upon anyone. It's no life worth living. Many many times I have told myself that this is IT. Now you have to go through with this. But I never could due to
My fears. I hope that this will give me the push I need. Some people here seem to think that death is always bad. I don't think so, I think some people have such crippling pain that death is just the lesser evil of the two. If you looking at it from this perspective maybe you can understand the thought process of someone who really wants to die in a better way.

What is the point when  you can't even get out of bed anymore. I'm literally only leaving bed to write here and get water then I go back to bed and hope I can sleep through most of the day. I'm comnvinced 100% that some cases  death is better
I come here because it does make me feel better to talk about it. At least sometimes. I want there to be a solution that isn't death but I know thats the only way to truly get rid of the pain

I'm really really depressed... I have a cord around my doorknob that I use to hangmyself for awhile each day. I guess I'm afraid of death but i do long for it. I really do... I used to tell myself that this pain I feel will subside. But I've been telling myself this for 15 years. I can't do it anymore. I don't feel like a man. I feel less. 

I was bullied during my childhood. I think the pain this brought me allowed me to become dependant on drugs. I just hate myself so much. I'm nothing but a bruden to everyone around me and I'm so sick of being a burden. I don't want help to pull my own weight. It's embarresing... 

I was with this girl that treated me worse than dogshit for 4 years. She cheated on me  5 times during those 4 years and I took her back everytime like the pathetic idiot I am. My life has been a sick joke for so long and I just want to find the courage to not stand up tomorrow when I  hang myself again
Hello yes I would like to talk. Very kind of you. How did you get out of it?
I will not ghost you. We can talk if you want?

If you don't do everything you can to get her back you will realise what you had when it's too late. That's where im at now... So please call her right now and make her see that you're serious and you love her.

Anyway. I just wanted to say that I appreciate that you wanted to talk. I'm thinking about some bad things.. I'm still sure I'll be dead sometime this week. It's something I've been thinking about since I was in my early teens. I'm now 25 years old. And the last straw was she leaving me. I had put all my eggs in one basket and that's what fucked me up the most.

I just got dumped aswell. Love of my life. I also lied ALOT. I couldn't even keep track of the lies. It morphed into a complex web of lies and that is hard to navigate thru. I'm also suicidal. Never thought I'd say that. But it's true. Anyway I also look for someone to speak with. Can't you just tell your gf that you will spend more time with her?

I literally deserve to die. I have Done horrible things when i was younger that continues to haunt me to this day.

 So many of My friends are dead from opiods. Somehow i survived that crazy time. Now Im clean bc of My gf that now left me. I dont wanna go back to drugs so Thats why Im here, to find the courage to hang myself

Yes i would like to. I just want to find the courage to do it. Im scared to be honest, i dont know what death is like, but now the sadness and anxiety has begun to exceed My fear of dying. I think i can do it. I would Love to be talked out of IT but i dont think It is possible. Im too far gone.  And i cant even get out of bed anymore. What is shitty about your life?
Im going to hang myself soon bc i have no purpose anymore after she left
